summary: ACCEPT. The revised specification resolves prior finding SPEC-4-1-001: User Story 2 scenario 3, edge cases, FR-010, the key-entity definitions, and SC-002 consistently distinguish resolved same-Repository Code Unit Edges from Unresolved Structural Relationship Candidates. The latter has a UUID; Scan Run, Repository, and source Code Unit identities; relationship kind; a non-empty, stable provider endpoint identity; no target Code Unit identity; deterministic deduplication; and no Document, Uncertainty, Edge, target-Repository identification, or Cross-Repository Resolution. The specification remains within the approved local CodeGraphContext boundary, keeps source and diagnostics safe, preserves authorization and Simplified-Chinese UI requirements, honors the user-authorized File Identity Hash, Range Confidence, and ScanRun/ScanRuns contracts, excludes LLM/MCP/Worker/Coordinator scope, and retains the mandatory independent-plan-review then explicit user-approval gate for the future Scan strategy without choosing that strategy. No Constitution MUST violation or Critical/High finding remains.
